name: ICE salvage (Ifosfamide / Carboplatin / Etoposide)

institution.provenance: StewardMD draft decision-support protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: ICE is highly emetogenic; give antiemetic prophylaxis before each cycle.

premedications.name: Mesna uroprotection
premedications.notes: Give mesna with and after ifosfamide to prevent hemorrhagic cystitis; ensure adequate hydration.

supportiveCare: Second-line salvage before autologous stem-cell transplant; aim for a chemosensitive (PET-negative) response, then mobilize/collect stem cells.
G-CSF support and monitoring for cytopenias (transplant-intent, marrow-sparing sequencing).
Ifosfamide neurotoxicity: monitor mental status; consider methylene blue for encephalopathy.
monitoring: CBC with differential before each cycle
renal function (carboplatin AUC and ifosfamide) before each cycle
restaging FDG-PET after salvage to assess chemosensitivity before transplant

drugs.name: Etoposide
drugs.notes: ICE 'E'. Etoposide 100 mg/m2 IV daily on days 1 to 3 of a 21-day cycle. Standard salvage dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).

drugs.name: Carboplatin
drugs.notes: ICE 'C'. Carboplatin dosed by Calvert formula to AUC 5 on day 2 (commonly capped at an absolute 800 mg per dose in practice). Standard salvage dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).

drugs.name: Ifosfamide
drugs.notes: ICE 'I'. Ifosfamide 5000 mg/m2 IV by 24-hour continuous infusion on day 2, given with mesna uroprotection. Standard salvage dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).
